notes: Account: mid-market B2B search/product discovery platform used by e-commerce customers.
Primary interest: improve SERP relevance by swapping current heuristic reranker (BM25 + logistic features) for neural reranker.
POC goals: show uplift in MRR/NDCG on their existing eval sets; maintain p95 latency < 250ms for rerank of top-10 candidates under p50 QPS of 25.
Data flow: candidate generation stays in-house (100 candidates), Redwood hosted rerank endpoint will accept batch of candidate docs + query for offline and online scoring.
Offline scoring requirement: must be able to run large offline scoring job (200k queries) against candidate set overnight with consistent model versioning and artifact export.
Evaluation metrics requested: MRR@10, NDCG@10, latency distribution, cost per 1k reranks; want automatic comparisons vs baseline.
Security: SSO/SAML required for console access; SOC2 compliance is mandatory for procurement; key rotation/KMS integration requested for Dedicated.

Deployment preference: start on Hosted API for 2-week POC, then migrate to Dedicated reserved pool if WL stability and cost look good. VPC peering for Dedicated is a hard requirement for some customers.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market — wants a predictable committed spend for Dedicated to lower per-rerank unit cost; asked for example unit math and break-even analysis.
Technical constraints: average document length 1.8k tokens after context + metadata; typical rerank input batch size 10, candidate gatherers produce 100/req.
Model preferences: open to Redwood-curated open models; also asked about quantized variants for Dedicated to reduce cost; fallbacks for capacity spikes requested.
SE notes: prepare an eval harness that uploads their labeled pairs and runs hosted reranker in both streaming and batch modes; include offline scoring CLI for their infra team.
